skills.name: Canary Validation Pattern
skills.description: Use minimal test actions to validate system behavior before relying on infrastructure for complex workflows.

skills.name: Always Verify File Operations
skills.description: Explicitly verify file operations succeeded by reading back the content; never assume write operations completed successfully.

skills.name: Match Effort to Task Complexity
skills.description: For trivial single-step tasks, execute immediately without elaborate planning, todo lists, or journal entries.
